paragraphs: In Niddah 59b they said: “And so Rabbi Abba ruled for Kala”; Hyman reports that Rashi and Tosafot explain that this is a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Niddah 59b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Abba ruling for Kala. The interpretation of Kala as a sage’s name remains Hyman’s report of Rashi and Tosafot; those commentaries were not freshly collated here. No identity binding follows.
